cities_reported_needs_source.name: cities_reported_needs_source
cities_reported_needs_source.value:
("cities"."reported_members" IS NULL AND "cities"."reported_prototypes" IS NULL)
          OR "cities"."reported_source" IS NOT NULL

cities_interest_needs_source.name: cities_interest_needs_source
cities_interest_needs_source.value: "cities"."interest_count" IS NULL OR "cities"."interest_source" IS NOT NULL

city_interest_verified_has_verifier.name: city_interest_verified_has_verifier
city_interest_verified_has_verifier.value: "city_interest"."verified_at" IS NULL OR "city_interest"."verified_by" IS NOT NULL

events_source_external_unique.name: events_source_external_unique
events_source_external_unique.where: "events"."source_id" IS NOT NULL AND "events"."external_id" IS NOT NULL

guides_author_identified.name: guides_author_identified
guides_author_identified.value: "guides"."author_builder_id" IS NOT NULL OR "guides"."author_name" IS NOT NULL

projects_public_recent_idx.name: projects_public_recent_idx
projects_public_recent_idx.where: publication_status = 'published' AND moderation_state = 'clean' AND deleted_at IS NULL

submissions_reviewed_has_reviewer.name: submissions_reviewed_has_reviewer
submissions_reviewed_has_reviewer.value: "submissions"."reviewed_at" IS NULL OR "submissions"."reviewer_id" IS NOT NULL

use_cases_author_identified.name: use_cases_author_identified
use_cases_author_identified.value: "use_cases"."author_builder_id" IS NOT NULL OR "use_cases"."author_name" IS NOT NULL
